pages.title: Gravitational Wave Crystal
pages.text: A ripple in spacetime itself, stretching and squeezing distances as it passes, frozen mid-oscillation. LIGO detected the first in 2015 from two merging black holes. The crystal pulses gently, alternately longer and shorter, as if breathing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Two spinning micro singularities in the Kugelblitz Chamber spiralled together and merged. Hawking radiation lit the scene, and the field equations captured the outgoing ripple before it escaped.
